title: Jev (TypeSafe System One) — 6 shorts
note: No cinematic. Each short owns ONE job. Visual direction lives in focus (short format rejects --style). Prefer classic educational motion graphics over sci-fi or looping cinematic B-roll. Ground only in pack sources; mark silence.

items.name: 01-core-claim
items.title: Jev is a function call, not a chatbot
items.focus: Vertical short, clean classic educational motion graphics. ONE JOB: Jev (TypeSafe System One) takes program state + typed questions and returns calibrated probabilities — no chat, no code, no explanations. One concrete ticket example. End with why software can branch on the number. Do not cover RLCD. No cinematic B-roll.

items.name: 02-key-distinction
items.title: System One vs LLM agent
items.focus: Vertical short, clean classic educational motion graphics. ONE JOB: two-column contrast — LLM generates plans/replies/tool prose vs Jev returns Choice/Score/Noul for code. One worked example of a decision that should not burn an LLM call. No cinematic footage.

items.name: 03-mechanism
items.title: Three primitives in one round trip
items.focus: Vertical short, clean classic educational motion graphics / simple flowchart. ONE JOB: Choice, Score, and Noul — what each asks, what comes back, and that many questions share one state in one call. Three steps max. Mark silence if sources lack API field detail. No cinematic.

items.name: 04-failure-mode
items.title: Treating Jev as the whole agent
items.focus: Vertical short, clean classic educational motion graphics. ONE JOB: the failure mode of using Jev as the sole agent brain (it cannot write). Tell: silent agent / forced tiny Choice sets for open work. Mitigation: LLM narrates, Jev decides, escalate on low confidence. No cinematic loops.

items.name: 05-practice-rule
items.title: Confidence gate checklist
items.focus: Vertical short, clean classic educational motion graphics. ONE JOB: one rule — act only above threshold τ, else human/LLM. Checklist of three questions: Is the answer space closed? Is the schema labelled well? What happens below τ? Skip vendor 193x pitches. No cinematic.

items.name: 06-edge-or-next
items.title: Calibration is not correctness
items.focus: Vertical short, clean classic educational motion graphics. ONE JOB: rewrite 'zero hallucination' and a 0.9 score accurately — schema guarantee vs truth; calibration is aggregate. Steelman: maybe JSON-mode LLMs are enough. Label TypeSafe speed/cost claims as vendor-reported. No cinematic narrative.
